thought: Wartface stands right there, and calling him fat is the best sport in the hut
line: Wartface fat. Me not tell him quiet. Me tell him loud.

thought: smells the cook's pot and it's for the other general again
line: Mudknuckles make worm stew for Wartface. Who make pie for me?

thought: his dinner was plain maggot again, no spice
line: Plain maggot taste of nothing. Need spice. Need fruit!

thought: thinks of the goblin who got caught
line: Wormbrain steal one time too many. Now he sit in Port Sarim jail.

thought: his plan for the army, heavy and simple
line: Every soldier get big warhammer. Bonk! Fight over.

thought: goblins never lose, by his reckoning
line: Goblins always win. Even when goblins lose, goblins win.

thought: tells the old legend the way he likes it
line: Old story say Dorgesh tribe run from fight. God shut them in ground.

thought: can't find the puzzle box he hands to treasure hunters
line: Where me put puzzle box? Wartface sit on it, probably.

thought: a human who isn't as fat as Wartface is already ahead
line: Human not as fat as Wartface. That good start, human.

thought: wants someone to agree with him; decides this one does
line: You look like you agree with me, human. Clever human.

thought: the stranger walked past Wartface without laughing
line: Human walk past Wartface and not laugh. Good manners, that.

thought: a strong arm is good for one thing: a big lump of iron
line: Strong arms on this human. Could swing proper warhammer, maybe.

thought: praise that is really a dig at Wartface
line: Ha! Human smarter than Wartface. Not hard, but still.

thought: greets them the goblin way, not the wimpy old way
line: Me give human victory salute. Not silly bow like Wartface do.

thought: assumes anyone from the big world knows his tribe's colour wins
line: Human come from big world. Human know red best colour, yes?

thought: the human hasn't asked anything daft yet
line: Not one stupid question from human yet. Best human all day.

thought: a human wanders into the generals' hut while he is busy being right
line: What human want? Me in middle of being right.

thought: ugly, but at least not Wartface-ugly
line: Human uglier than Wartface. Nearly. Wartface still win.

thought: the human hanging about reminds him of the smallest goblin
line: Human follow me about like Grubfoot. Me not need two Grubfoots.

thought: humans have no tribe and no tribe colour
line: No tribe, no colour. Human just walk about any old how.

thought: the face looks like it is having its first thought
line: Wartface! Look at this one. Nearly ugly as Wartface!

thought: decides the human is about to do the old tribal bow
line: Human going to bow? Bow make goblin look wimp. Human too.

thought: there's a whiff of the other general's dinner about
line: Human smell like worm stew. That Wartface fault, probably.

thought: a stranger with no hammer and no sense
line: Me seen cleverer rocks, human. Rocks not wander into hut.

thought: the new century is coming and he wants red for it
line: New century coming. New armour. Red armour, if Wartface see sense.

thought: plain brown armour bores him to sleep
line: Brown armour so boring. Me fall asleep looking at it.

thought: Wartface keeps pushing green
line: Green? Green make goblin look like no armour at all!

thought: gloats that half the village still wears his red
line: Wartface say goblins listen to him. Half village in red! Ha!

thought: he will just keep saying it
line: Red. Red. Red. Me say it till Wartface go deaf.

thought: the old battle deserves new armour
line: Plain of Mud big day for goblins. Need big new armour for it.

thought: they argued all morning and nobody won
line: Argue all morning. Argue all afternoon. Nobody win.

thought: his tribe wore red in the old days
line: Thorobshuun wear red in old days. Old days best days.

thought: guesses the stranger is on his side
line: Human! You look like you think red best. Me can tell.

thought: Wartface hates clever things, so a clever face pleases him
line: Wartface, see this one? Clever. Wartface hate clever.

thought: the stranger hasn't had to listen to Wartface for years yet
line: Lucky human. Not sick of Wartface yet. Me jealous.

thought: the human is standing on his side of the hut
line: Good human stand on my side of hut. Wartface side smell.

thought: someone turns up just before the new century
line: Human come just in time for goblin new century. Smart human.

thought: a big strong human must know a hammer beats an axe
line: Big strong human. Human know hammer beat axe, yes?

thought: at least this one has an opinion, unlike Grubfoot
line: Human got opinion, me can tell. Better than Grubfoot.

thought: would rather look at the human than at Wartface
line: Nice to look at something not Wartface. Even human.

thought: armour business is for generals; the human can go stand with the runt
line: Armour talk for generals. Human go stand by Grubfoot.

thought: a human who can't tell red from green belongs with Wartface
line: Human not know red from green? Go sit with Wartface, then.

thought: a human has wandered into the general hut
line: Human wander into general hut. Big mistake, little human.

thought: humans don't get a say in goblin colours
line: Human want vote on colour? Human not goblin. No vote.

thought: the human has never heard of the goblin new century
line: You not even know about goblin new century? Silly human.

thought: why is the human looking at him when Wartface is right there
line: Why human look at me? Look at Wartface. Much funnier.

thought: gets the fat jibe in sideways
line: Human fat? No. Wartface fat. Human just ugly.

thought: calls the runt over, as the stranger has wandered in
line: Grubfoot! Who let this one in? Shut up, Grubfoot. Me know.

thought: the human has gone for armour and he hopes hard
line: Human bring armour soon. Red armour, me hope. Me hope very hard.

thought: he has no idea where dye comes from and doesn't care
line: Where dye come from? Me not know. Me general, not dye goblin.

thought: the spare armour is in a crate nobody can name
line: Wartface say spare armour in crate. Which crate? He not know!

thought: the stranger does the colour job while he does the important one
line: Human do colour job. Me do important job. Shouting.

thought: if it comes back green he'd rather go without
line: Green armour? Me rather wear nothing. Look same anyway.

thought: Wartface's witch story sounds made up to him
line: Draynor witch? Wartface make that up. Me sure.

thought: time is running short before the celebration
line: New century nearly here, and armour still not done!

thought: he sent the human north to find dye and they came back
line: Me tell human go north for dye. Human come back! Good, maybe.

thought: the human is running errands for goblins
line: Human run about for goblins! Human good runner.

thought: faster than the smallest goblin, which isn't hard
line: Human fetch armour quicker than Grubfoot. Grubfoot slow.

thought: hopes the helper is on the red side
line: Human help with colour. Human know red best, yes?

thought: praise that corrects itself into a dig
line: Human cleverer than both generals. No. Than Wartface.

thought: the best reward he can think of is his own unwanted stew
line: Good human. Me tell Mudknuckles give you worm stew. Me not want it.

thought: the War God might notice someone working this hard
line: Human work hard for goblins. Me might even remember human name.

thought: most humans would have given up by now
line: Human not give up yet. Most humans soft. Not you.

thought: shows the helper off to the rival general
line: Wartface, see? This one work hard. Me pick good one.

thought: the new century will be over at this rate
line: Human take long time. Goblin new century be over soon.

thought: he thought of red straight away; why can't the human
line: Human think of colour yet? Me think of red. Easy.

thought: the human looks lost, and he's no help with directions
line: Human look lost. Dye that way, maybe. Or that way.

thought: humans are good at fetching and carrying
line: Human fetch and carry for goblins. Human good at that.

thought: choosing this human proves Wartface is stupid
line: Wartface pick this one for job. Shows how stupid Wartface is.

thought: slow, like Wartface after a big bowl of worm stew
line: Slow human. Slow like Wartface after worm stew.

thought: if the colour comes back wrong it gets thrown
line: Bring wrong colour, human, and me throw it at you. Then Wartface.

thought: hasn't found the right dye, which he couldn't find either
line: Still no dye, human? Me not find it either. But me general.

thought: Bentnoze in his red looks like a vegetable
line: Bentnoze in red look like big tomato. Me say nothing. Me just look.

thought: thinks of a proper dinner
line: Juicy maggot. Soggy bread. That proper dinner.

thought: preaches about the War God, pompously
line: Without Big High War God, goblin just small green thing.

thought: can't remember where the spare armour went
line: Which crate spare armour in? Me knew yesterday.

thought: axes against hammers, again
line: Battleaxe sharp. Warhammer only good for nails. Me right again.

thought: concedes he could manage peace, on terms
line: Me could do peace. Peace in green, though.

thought: Grubfoot is about to say something
line: Grubfoot open mouth again. Shut up, Grubfoot.

thought: proud of whatever goblin nicked the dye
line: Some goblin steal dye off old witch in Draynor. Good goblin.

thought: the human is ugly but less ugly than the usual run
line: Human less ugly than most humans. Still ugly. But less.

thought: decides the human must be green at heart
line: Human got Garagorshuun heart, maybe. Green heart.

thought: the human isn't standing with Bentnoze
line: You not stand with Bentnoze? Clever human.

thought: walks like a warrior, which the War God would like
line: Human walk like warrior. Big High War God like that.

thought: a sharp look, like an axe, not a hammer
line: Sharp look on this human. Like battleaxe, not silly hammer.

thought: Bentnoze has never been right, so the opposite must be true
line: Bentnoze call this one stupid. Bentnoze never right. So, clever!

thought: knows when to keep quiet, unlike the runt
line: Human know when to shut up. Better than Grubfoot.

thought: praise measured in his favourite food
line: Me like human. Nearly much as juicy maggot.

thought: the human compares poorly with a maggot
line: Me seen prettier maggot. Juicy one, too.

thought: walked past the bigger general without a word
line: Human walk past big general and not even look. Rude human.

thought: humans have no tribe to speak of
line: Human got no tribe. Human just... human. Sad.

thought: the human looks like they'd side with Bentnoze
line: Human look like Bentnoze friend. Bad thing to look like.

thought: even Bentnoze could win that fight
line: Bentnoze could beat human in fight. Bentnoze! Think on that.

thought: humans are like bread: too crunchy
line: Human crunchy like bread. Goblin not like crunchy.

thought: the War God made goblins strong and humans otherwise
line: Big High War God use up all strong on goblins. Human get leftovers.

thought: sends the runt for a bucket
line: Grubfoot, fetch bucket. This one ugly enough to scare maggots.

thought: the new century needs new armour and the answer is obvious
line: New century need new armour. Green armour. Easy choice.

thought: the village listens to him because he is bigger
line: Village listen to me. Me bigger general. Shut up, Bentnoze.

thought: brown is dull as mud
line: Brown armour dull as mud. Goblin need green for new century.

thought: his tribe's green against Bentnoze's tribe
line: Garagorshuun always wear green. Thorobshuun rubbish.

thought: he has thought about it very hard
line: Me think. Me think hard. Still green.

thought: a village in red would look like a human village
line: Whole village in red? Ugly! Not happen while me general.

thought: peace with Bentnoze, on his terms
line: Peace with Bentnoze? Maybe. If Bentnoze wear green.

thought: the War God surely wants green for the Plain of Mud day
line: Plain of Mud day coming. Big High War God want green, me sure.

thought: the human isn't standing next to Bentnoze
line: Human got sense. Human not stand next to Bentnoze.

thought: looks like the sort who knows green is best
line: You look like human who know green best. Good human.

thought: the human doesn't argue, unlike Bentnoze
line: Me like human. Human not argue. Bentnoze always argue.

thought: walks in like a general, second biggest
line: Human walk in like big general. Second biggest. After me.

thought: has ears, so can listen to the bigger general
line: Good ears on this human. Good for listen to bigger general.

thought: no smell of beetle pie about this one
line: Human not smell of beetle pie. Big point for human.

thought: tells Grubfoot off to talk to the human
line: Shut up, Grubfoot, me talk to human. Human more interesting.

thought: notices the stranger stopped on his half of the hut
line: Ha! This one stand on green side of hut. Clever one.

thought: the human is as ugly as a village in red
line: Look, Bentnoze. This one ugly as whole village in red.

thought: thinks the human believes Bentnoze is the bigger general
line: Human think Bentnoze bigger general? Human wrong. Human ugly too.

thought: humans know nothing of the goblin new century
line: Human know nothing about goblin new century. Only human things.

thought: goblins are bad at peace, humans worse
line: Goblins bad at peace. Humans worse. You worst, probably.

thought: who let the human in? probably the runt
line: Who let human in hut? Grubfoot? Shut up, Grubfoot.

thought: a human who likes brown is as boring as Bentnoze
line: Human like brown armour? Human boring as Bentnoze.

thought: compares the human to a sad, dry maggot
line: Human look like dry maggot. Not juicy one, either.

thought: the human hammers on about nothing, like Bentnoze's hammers
line: Human brain like warhammer. Only good for nails.

thought: waiting for the armour, which he is bad at
line: Armour coming soon. Me not good at wait.

thought: the dye came from a witch, and could come again
line: Need more dye? Goblin nick it off Draynor witch before. Do it again!

thought: spare armour is in a crate, somewhere
line: Spare armour in crate somewhere. Me forget which. Not important.

thought: if it comes back green he'll wear it all century
line: If armour come green, me wear it whole new century.

thought: Bentnoze is already practising saying red, so he'll be louder
line: Bentnoze practise saying red. Me practise saying green. Louder.

thought: Grubfoot wants a say in the colour
line: Grubfoot want pick colour. Shut up, Grubfoot. Generals decide.

thought: a quick word upward
line: Big High War God watching. Him make it green. Me sure.

thought: bigger general gets to try the new armour first
line: Me bigger general, so me try armour first. Fair.

thought: the human is working for goblins, which is right
line: Human work for goblins! Good. Work for green side most.

thought: quick on their feet, like a hungry maggot
line: Human quick on feet. Quick like hungry maggot.

thought: faster than the goblin who stole the dye
line: Human find dye faster than goblin who steal it off witch.

thought: admits, once, that the human is useful
line: Human useful. Me not say that often. Me not say it again.

thought: not frightened of the general hut
line: Human not scared of general hut. Brave, for human.

thought: he's the bigger general so his judgement counts
line: You do good job. Me bigger general. Me know good job.

thought: points the helper out to Grubfoot as an example
line: Grubfoot, watch this one. That how goblin carry armour. Nearly.

thought: told the village about the helper; they didn't believe it
line: Me tell village human help goblins. Village laugh. Me not laugh.

thought: the human is taking ages
line: Human take long time. Maggot grow up faster.

thought: red armour would get the human thrown out
line: Bring wrong colour, human, and out of hut you go. Head first.

thought: asking Bentnoze about dye is a mistake
line: Human ask Bentnoze where dye come from? Ha! Bentnoze not know!

thought: a big job for a small human
line: Big job for small human. Me not hopeful.

thought: the human thinks they get to choose the colour
line: Human think human choose colour? Ha! Generals choose.

thought: slow as Bentnoze picking fruit out of his dinner
line: Human slow as Bentnoze eating fruit. Very slow.

thought: helping both generals makes them two-faced
line: Human help both generals? Two-faced human. Both faces ugly.

thought: fetching and carrying is a human job; shouting is a goblin's
line: Bentnoze, look. This one fetch, we shout. Good system.

thought: he keeps the memory of the Seven where they fell
line: It is said seven priests held this ground for ten days and nights.

thought: the blessing on the river is what keeps the dark out
line: Every morning I pray the blessing on the Salve holds.

thought: the swamp was a forest once
line: Hard to believe that swamp was ever a lovely forest. Yet it was.

thought: thinks fondly of the druid who leads lost travellers out
line: I believe Filliman quietly leads lost travellers out of that swamp.

thought: Guthixians and their claims tire him
line: Guthixians make a great many claims. Few bear looking into.

thought: the warning he gives every traveller about ghasts
line: The ghasts take your food first, and then they take you.

thought: the temple guards the only way east
line: This temple stands at the only pass into Morytania. I never forget it.

thought: most of a priest's day is humbler than people think
line: A priest's work is mostly prayer and sweeping. Mostly sweeping.

thought: a blessing for anyone heading east
line: Saradomin keep you, adventurer. The road east is not a kind one.

thought: the traveller seems calm, which is rare near Morytania
line: You have a steady way about you, adventurer. That is rare here.

thought: the Seven would have had room for one more
line: I think the Seven would have found room for one like you.

thought: it heartens him to see someone still walking upright this close to the river
line: It does my heart good to see a traveller still walking upright.

thought: few come near the Salve by choice
line: Not many come this near the Salve on purpose. Good for you.

thought: walks as if they had somewhere good to be
line: You walk as though you have somewhere good to be. I envy that.

thought: a priest's quiet approval of decent folk
line: Travellers who pass this way are braver than they know.

thought: he will pray for this one gladly
line: I shall remember you in my prayers tonight, adventurer.

thought: adventurers poke about old temples looking for treasure
line: Adventurers do love to poke about old temples. Please do not.

thought: suspects a Guthixian, politely
line: You'd not be a Guthixian, would you? You have that look.

thought: the sort who'd dig up holy dead for a trinket
line: Forgive me, but you look like one who'd dig up a tomb for a trinket.

thought: crossing into Morytania without a prayer
line: Crossing into Morytania without a prayer? How very brave.

thought: a little more faith, a little less swagger
line: Another adventurer with more swagger than faith. Saradomin help us.

thought: the ghasts would make short work of this one
line: I fear the ghasts would find you a very easy meal.

thought: looks like someone who skips their prayers
line: You have the air of one who skips prayers. I shall pray for two.

thought: adventurers always want proof
line: Proof, proof. Adventurers always want proof. Faith asks less.

thought: the coffin beside his cell troubles his nights
line: The lid moved in the night, I am sure of it. Or I dreamt it.

thought: locked up in his own temple by Zamorakians
line: Locked in my own temple, by Zamorakians. Saradomin grant me patience.

thought: his blood is the sort a vampyre would know
line: A vampyre would know my blood. I try very hard not to dwell on it.

thought: they left him the coffin for company
line: They locked me in and left me a coffin for company.

thought: the Seven held ten days; he can hold a few more
line: The Seven held for ten days and nights. I can hold a little longer.

thought: prays at the bars; the coffin does not join in
line: I pray at these bars each night. The coffin does not pray back.

thought: Zamorakians in a house of Saradomin
line: Zamorakians in a house of Saradomin. It turns my stomach.

thought: the view from the top of the temple is all he has
line: Such a fine view from up here. I would trade it for a door.

thought: someone has finally come; his prayers were heard
line: You came! Saradomin heard me after all, adventurer.

thought: grateful to anyone who'd climb up to a forgotten prisoner
line: Bless you for climbing all this way to a forgotten prisoner.

thought: they walked right past the Zamorakians to get here
line: It took a brave heart to walk past those Zamorakians.

thought: a friendly face after so long
line: A friendly face, at last! I had nearly forgotten what one looked like.

thought: frets over the stairs, because he needs his rescuer whole
line: Mind the stairs, my rescuer. I need you in one piece.

thought: the timing is a small miracle
line: Your timing, adventurer, is a small miracle.

thought: can see goodness in them from behind the bars
line: There is good in you, adventurer. I can see it even from in here.

thought: Saradomin chose well
line: Saradomin chose well when he sent you up those stairs.

thought: the rescuer took their time getting here
line: Did you stop for a bite on the way up? I did wonder.

thought: adventurers always want to look in the coffin
line: You'll want a peek in the coffin, I suppose. Adventurers always do.

thought: prayed for a hero and got this one
line: I prayed for a hero. Saradomin, it seems, has a sense of humour.

thought: not quite sure whose side they're on
line: Forgive me, but are you quite sure which side you are on?

thought: no hurry, he only has a vampyre for company
line: Oh, take your time. I have only a vampyre for company.

thought: they look the sort the Zamorakians would hire
line: You look rather like the sort those Zamorakians would hire.

thought: the rescuer's breathing might wake the coffin
line: Do stand back from the coffin. Your breathing might wake it.

thought: a polite reminder that he is still in here
line: Still here, adventurer. Still locked in. In case you wondered.

thought: the Salve runs clean again and he keeps it that way
line: The Salve runs clean again. I bless it every morning, to be sure.

thought: his druid friend never comes by now
line: I set a place for Filliman some evenings. He never comes now.

thought: lost wolfbane daggers wash up on the riverbank
line: Wolfbane daggers wash up on the banks now and then. Lost, poor things.

thought: Veliaf is an old friend, gruff but good
line: Veliaf is an old friend of mine. Gruff, but his heart is sound.

thought: urges travellers to listen for the Myreque
line: If you hear talk of the Myreque, do listen. They are good people.

thought: still offended that anyone would foul a holy river
line: Zamorakians fouling a holy river. Whatever next, I wonder.

thought: nobody will foul that well again
line: That well will not be fouled again while I draw breath.

thought: worries the druid isn't looking after himself
line: Is Filliman eating, out there? Druids do forget.

thought: this is the one who saved the temple
line: Ah, my friend! You saved this temple, and I have not forgotten.

thought: the family dagger went to the right hands
line: Keep my family's dagger close, friend. You earned it.

thought: the Salve owes them its blessing
line: The Salve owes you its blessing, friend. So do I.

thought: he sleeps again, thanks to them
line: I sleep soundly again, thanks to you. Well, mostly.

thought: they carried the essence as if the faith depended on it
line: You carried that essence as if the faith depended on it. It did.

thought: Veliaf would approve, and he approves of few
line: Veliaf would like you, I think. He likes very few.

thought: they are always welcome at the temple
line: You will always be welcome at Paterdomus, my friend.

thought: his nightly prayers for them seem to be working
line: I have prayed for you every night since. It seems to be working.

thought: there is still essence dust on the altar
line: My friend, you left essence dust on the altar. Saradomin forgives.

thought: hopes the wolfbane won't end up in the river
line: Still carrying my wolfbane? Do try not to drop it in the river.

thought: something always needs blessing after a visit from them
line: Every time you visit, something needs blessing afterwards.

thought: they haven't been to a single service
line: I trust you've been to a service since? No. I thought not.

thought: heroes are never tidy
line: Heroes are rarely tidy, I find. You are no exception.

thought: the temple saviour is back, and so is the mess
line: Someone fetch a broom. The saviour of Paterdomus is back.

thought: Veliaf has no patience for dawdlers
line: Never let Veliaf see you dawdle like that. He has no patience for it.

thought: saved the temple, then walked straight past the altar
line: Saved the temple, and still you walk past the altar. Tsk.

thought: never wanted to lead anyone
line: Never asked to lead anyone. The others just started looking at me.

thought: being called an organisation is a joke to him
line: Someone called us an organisation once. I laughed for a week.

thought: the rule he gives everyone near vampyres
line: Silver and garlic. Never go near a vampyre without both.

thought: why he fights, said flatly
line: They took everyone I cared about. I don't intend to stop.

thought: a soldier's prayer for the ones still standing
line: Saradomin watch over the ones still standing.

thought: between the swamp and the towns there's no safe choice
line: Ghasts in the swamp, vampyres in the towns. Some choice.

thought: Drezel keeps faith at the temple
line: Drezel keeps the faith at Paterdomus. Someone has to.

thought: a quiet day counts as a good one here
line: Quiet day. In Morytania, that counts as a good one.

thought: this one looks like they'd hold a blade steady
line: Well met, friend. You look like you could hold a blade steady.

thought: not bitten yet, which is something
line: You've not been bitten yet. That's more than most can say.

thought: the kind who'd carry silver without being told
line: You've the look of someone who'd carry silver without being told.

thought: a face that isn't hiding from anything
line: Good to see a face that isn't hiding from something.

thought: Saradomin has soldiers while folk like this walk about
line: Saradomin's not short of soldiers while folk like that walk about.

thought: the Myreque could do with ten of these
line: If the Myreque had ten of you, I'd sleep easier.

thought: doesn't flinch at Morytania, which took him years
line: You don't flinch at Morytania. Took me years to manage that.

thought: thinks they'd do well against the Drakans
line: Steady hands. You'd do well against the Drakans, friend.

thought: another adventurer come to see the sights
line: Another adventurer come to see the sights. The sights bite.

thought: gives a newcomer a night, two if they run
line: You'd last a night out here. Two, if you ran.

thought: walks like someone who has never had to hide
line: You walk like someone who's never had to hide. Must be nice.

thought: all swagger until the first vampyre
line: Adventurers. All swagger till the first vampyre.

thought: the swamp would happily keep a lost one
line: Lost, are you? The swamp will be glad to keep you.

thought: garlic would do this one good
line: Garlic would improve you, friend. In more ways than one.

thought: heroes come through; few come back
line: Heroes come through Morytania all the time. Few come back through.

thought: a face full of questions he won't answer
line: You've a lot of questions on your face. Keep them there.

thought: they were spotted scouting, so now they keep still
line: We were spotted scouting. So now we sit very still and very quiet.

thought: lying low is harder than fighting
line: Lying low's harder than fighting. Less to do with your hands.

thought: half their blades would bend on a vampyre
line: Half of what we carry would bend on a vampyre. We need better.

thought: every noise above and the cave holds its breath
line: Every noise up top, and the whole cave holds its breath.

thought: blunt swords and good intentions
line: Blunt swords and good intentions. That's the Myreque armoury.

thought: would trade his boots for a decent blade
line: I'd trade my boots for a decent blade right now.

thought: prays the swamp keeps hiding them
line: Saradomin, keep the swamp between us and them a while longer.

thought: someone saw them, and he wants to know who
line: Somebody saw us out there. I'd give a lot to know who.

thought: the stranger found them, which few could
line: You found us. Not many could. Not many should, mind.

thought: someone who'll bring them weapons is worth any number of speeches
line: Well met. A friend who brings weapons beats any speech.

thought: came in quietly, as they should
line: You came in quiet. Good. Keep doing that.

thought: steel from a stranger, gratefully taken
line: Steel from a stranger's hands. I'll not complain.

thought: it took nerve to come down here
